result.topic_en: Euler notes that for odd m+n the expected relation among sums of odd powers fails to appear, then observes that the series of the form ∫1/z^{m+n-1}(1/y) can always be determined exactly, and lists these determinations for the case m+n even.
result.transcription:
SERIES SINGVLARES. 163

pendent, nulla ratio habeatur. Ex quo etiam ex-
pectare licuisset, pro ordinibus, quibus $m+n$ est
numerus impar, similem relationem inter summas
potestatum imparium prodire debuisse, quod autem
longe secus vsu venit, cum determinationum, quae
pro his ordinibus reperiuntur, quaedam plane inter
se conueniant, vt nihil prorsus inde concludi queat.
Quod cum praeter omnem expectationem euenerit,
iste defectus plenae determinationis omni attentione
dignus est censendus.
21. Tertio obseruandum est, in omnibus or-
dinibus vnam seriem nostrae formae semper perfecte
determinari, eam scilicet, quae formula $\int\frac{1}{z^{m+n-1}}\left(\frac{1}{y}\right)$
indicatur; cum autem eius determinationes, prouti
$m+n$ fuerit numerus impar vel par, aliam le-
gem sequantur, eas seorsim hic ob oculos ponamus:

Pro ordinibus quibus m + n est numerus
par.

$\int\frac{1}{z^3}\left(\frac{1}{y}\right)=\frac{3}{2}[?]\int\frac{1}{z^2}\cdot\int\frac{1}{z^2}-\frac{5}{2}\int\frac{1}{z^4}$

items.quote: Tertio obseruandum est, in omnibus ordinibus vnam seriem nostrae formae semper perfecte determinari, eam scilicet, quae formula $\int\frac{1}{z^{m+n-1}}\left(\frac{1}{y}\right)$ indicatur
items.english: Thirdly, it should be observed that in all orders one series of our form is always perfectly determined, namely the one indicated by the formula ∫1/z^{m+n-1}(1/y).

items.quote: quod autem longe secus vsu venit, cum determinationum, quae pro his ordinibus reperiuntur, quaedam plane inter se conueniant, vt nihil prorsus inde concludi queat.
items.english: But in practice it turned out quite otherwise, since some of the determinations found for these orders coincide completely with one another, so that nothing at all can be concluded from them.

items.quote: iste defectus plenae determinationis omni attentione dignus est censendus.
items.english: This lack of a complete determination must be judged worthy of every attention.
